newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa bonds strong, rand trendless at noon.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa bonds strong, rand trendless at noon.

text.p: 1000 GMT - Bonds hold firmer levels following jobber short-covering and offshore and local institutional buying. Rand steady in trendless, thin volume trade.

* R150 at 14.23 pct from 14.26 pct close. Dealers say retracement from earlier high of 14.29 pct helped by local jobbers, who went short after disappointing reserves number overnight, covering. Local and offshore institutional interest seen.
* Market busy and taking cue from falling short-end rates. Dealers expect further gains in long-end in afternoon. Range on R150 predicted at 14.23 to 14.18 pct.
* Rand at 4.5310/5340 on dollar from 4.5285/5315 on Tuesday. Dealers seeing two-way interest from London, but market trendless after July 1 fx easing passes with no detrimental impact on market.
